source: stage D: SLICEM sites hold instances of type SLICEM or SLICEL; in ISE's bitstreams of the reference designs and the PIP batches, the 142 SLICEM instances set these bits, the 553 SLICEL instances in SLICEM sites do not. _GND_SOURCE and XBUSED removed from blinky / lab11 placed and routed by Silinx (gen-attrdrop.mjs, ana-attrdrop.mjs): no bits of their own (without XBUSED, bitgen leaves out the carry settings)
